reuse.why: Fintegra uses the existing linking workflow and bank lookup, shares Akahu's downloader, and reuses extracted unlink cleanup.

duplication.why: Link policies, transaction downloading, and local unlink cleanup are shared rather than copied into new provider paths.

placement.why: Link policy stays in account orchestration, downloads stay in sync.ts, and provider configuration and models follow existing boundaries.

scope.why: The changes address the four requests, apart from an unrelated schedule import reorder.

maintainability.why: All providers share the link safeguards and replacement policy, with provider differences expressed through existing adapters and focused helper parameters.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers call linkBankSyncAccount, and replacement and ordinary unlinking both call clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The renamed transaction downloader serves both Akahu and Fintegra, and extracted unlink cleanup replaces the original block.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount adds institution, bankId, and replaceExistingLink while removing bank; the generalized downloader adds serverUrl and providerName; these represent required inputs without provider-specific exceptions or bypassing callers.
